Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Rupali Ranade. I am a 55-year-old fashion designer living in Surat. I have a tenancy problem with Sneha Shah involving 1.6 lakh rupees in rent, and the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months. My case number is R.C.A. No. 2222/2022 in the Surat District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 75642 98712 or email rupali.ranade43@example.com.
